title: Make Your Birthday Party Sweeter With Fresh Cane
description: Fresh sugarcane juice pressed live at your birthday party or private celebration – naturally sweet, alcohol-free and loved by all ages.
excerpt: Fresh sugarcane juice pressed live at your birthday party or private celebration – naturally sweet, alcohol-free and loved by all ages.
imageAlt: The CaneHouse sugarcane juice stall at a celebration
author: The CaneHouse Team
html:
Whether it is a first birthday, a big milestone or a garden party with friends, fresh sugarcane juice adds a refreshing touch to your celebration. We bring the stall, press the cane live and serve your guests straight from the press.

Loved by every age

Sugarcane juice is naturally sweet – all the sweetness comes from the cane itself – and it is alcohol-free, so children and grown-ups can enjoy the same drink. Watching the cane go through the press is half the fun, especially for younger guests.

Pick your party flavours

Alongside the classic glass, choose from flavours such as:

  • Mint – cool and refreshing on a hot day
  • Pineapple and Watermelon – fruity favourites
  • Orange and Mixed Fruit – bright and juicy
  • Lemon & Ginger or Masala – for guests who like a little kick

Celebrations we cater for

Birthdays, family parties, college fests, festivals and private parties – if there are thirsty guests, we can be there. Sugarcane has been shared at festivals and family gatherings for generations, so it feels right at home at a celebration. Learn more on all about cane.

Booking your party

Every party package is tailored to your guest numbers, flavours, serving hours and budget. Smaller events can often be arranged within a few days; for weekends we recommend booking 4–8 weeks ahead.

We are based in Sutton and serve London and Surrey.

Planning a party? Tell us about it and we will send you a quote, or see more on our events page.
